crt.description: An old CRT screen: a curved picture, scanlines, darker corners.

chromatic.description: Chromatic aberration: red and blue pulled apart toward the edges.

wave.description: The picture ripples, as seen through moving water.

glitch.description: Bands of the picture jump sideways and split their colours, now and then.

kaleidoscope.description: The picture mirrored into segments around the centre, turning.

vhs.description: A worn videotape: colour bleeding sideways, a rolling bright band, noise, jitter.
